verdict.rationale: The evidence documents CPU optimizations only for x86 (AVX/AVX2/AVX512/AMX) and ARM (NEON on Apple silicon), which are the two architectures this story explicitly looks beyond. Nothing in the pack mentions PowerPC, RISC-V, s390x or any other CPU architecture. The dependency-free plain C/C++ implementation hints at portability but is not evidence of support for other architectures.
